### Description of the Page:
The page presents a structured list of elective courses at The University of Jordan, including details about each course. It features two sections: one for courses requiring 21 credit hours and another for courses requiring 15 credit hours. Each section consists of columns labeled for the course number, course name, credit hours, theoretical hours, and practical hours. The design is tabular, providing clarity on the requirements and structure of the courses. Additionally, there are notes at the bottom, indicating further details about the included courses.
